record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: For m >= n, prove that every LLT-polynomial gamma_{m,n}(x;t) associated to an (m,n)-Dyck path has an elementary-basis expansion with coefficients in N[r] after the specialization t=1+r, i.e. 0 <=_e gamma_{m,n}(x;1+r). This would help explain both Schur positivity of g_d^(a,b)(x;q,t) and e-positivity of g_d^(a,b)(x;q,1+r) when such functions expand positively in these LLT-polynomials.

evidence.quote: we have experimentally observed that these LLT-polynomials expand positively in the elementary function basis when spe-cialized at t = 1 + r

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $m \geq n$ be positive integers. An $(m,n)$-Dyck path is a lattice path from $(0,0)$ to $(m,n)$ using unit north and east steps that stays weakly above the diagonal from $(0,0)$ to $(m,n)$. To each $(m,n)$-Dyck path $\pi$ one associates an LLT polynomial $\gamma_{m,n}(x;t) \in \Lambda[t]$, a symmetric function in the variables $x = (x_1,x_2,\dots)$ with polynomial coefficients in $t$, defined as the sum over standard fillings (or, equivalently, $t$-weighted ribbon tableaux) determined by the cells of $\pi$ that lie strictly above the diagonal.

Let $\{e_\lambda\}$ denote the elementary symmetric function basis of $\Lambda$. Perform the substitution $t = 1 + r$ in $\gamma_{m,n}(x;t)$ and expand:
$$\gamma_{m,n}(x;1+r) = \sum_{\lambda} c_\lambda(r)\, e_\lambda(x).$$

Prove that for every $(m,n)$-Dyck path with $m \geq n$, the coefficients $c_\lambda(r)$ all lie in $\mathbb{N}[r]$, i.e. they are polynomials in $r$ with nonnegative integer coefficients.
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous e-positivity at t = 1 + r is known for unicellular LLT polynomials (D'Adderio; Alexandersson–Sulzgruber) and for vertical-strip LLT polynomials. For the general rational (m,n)-Dyck path LLT polynomials with m ≥ n, the conjectured e-positivity after specialization t = 1 + r appears to remain a conjecture/open problem; we did not find a complete proof in the literature.

status_evidence.title: e-Positivity of vertical strip LLT polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: M. D'Adderio proved e-positivity of vertical strip LLT polynomials (at t = 1 + r)
status_evidence.claim: Vertical-strip / unicellular case proved by D'Adderio.

status_evidence.title: LLT polynomials, elementary symmetric functions and melting lollipops
status_evidence.snippet: e-positivity results for unicellular LLT polynomials at t = 1 + r
status_evidence.claim: Unicellular LLT e-positivity at t = 1 + r is established.

status_evidence.title: e-Positivity Results and Conjectures (Haglund)
status_evidence.snippet: LLT polynomials generated by Dyck paths whether classical or rational do exhibit the e-positivity phenomenon
status_evidence.claim: Rational (m,n)-Dyck path LLT e-positivity at t = 1 + r is a conjecture/observation.
